title: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery (Premium): hold reports for GCC, GCC High and DoD
summary: The briefing matches the roadmap and distinguishes the documented preview from the planned Government release. Its commands, subscription requirements and permissions are supported; the role-assignment path omits only a page heading.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans eDiscovery (Premium) hold reports in the Microsoft Purview portal.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview compliance portal:  eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold reports (U.S. Government clouds)

claims.claim: The planned reports are out-of-the-box reports about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases.
claims.quote: Out-of-the-box reports that contain information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: The preview page warns that policy and location status sync no more than once every seven days.
claims.quote: The report syncs policy and location status no more than once every seven days, so the information shown might not reflect recent changes to your hold policies.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: The hold policy details page in the case gives the current status of a specific hold and its locations.
claims.quote: For the current status of a specific hold policy and its locations, go to the hold policy details page in the Microsoft Purview eDiscovery case.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Applied partially is a preview policy status indicating that some locations might not have the hold applied.
claims.quote: Applied Partially: – Indicates that the hold policy that the location is part of is set to be turned on (enabled) and has some locations where the hold might not be applied.

claims.claim: Released partially is an available preview policy status.
claims.quote: Released partially: Indicates that the hold policy that the location is part of is set to be turned off (disabled) and has some locations where the hold might not be released.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Policy failed is a preview status indicating incorrectly configured policies that are not enforced.
claims.quote: Policy failed: Indicates that the policy is set up incorrectly. The policy doesn't have a rule or was set up with rule set as disabled. These policies aren't enforced even if the policy status is successful.

claims.claim: The preview page tells administrators to create a rule and resync a failed policy.
claims.quote: To ensure these policies are enforced, create a rule and resync the policy. For more information, see New-CaseHoldRule.

claims.claim: The preview report includes the user who created the policy.
claims.quote: Policy created by: Shows the user that created the initial hold policy.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The preview report includes the user who last modified the policy.
claims.quote: Policy last modified by: Shows the user that last modified the hold policy.

claims.claim: The preview report can display the policy's rule query.
claims.quote: Rule query: Displays any content match query that is applied to the policy. If there's no content match query applied to the policy, this field is empty.

claims.claim: Managers are assigned at Microsoft Purview portal > Settings > Role groups > eDiscovery Manager > Edit > Manage eDiscovery Manager > Choose users.
claims.quote: Go to Settings > Role groups. ... On Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions, select eDiscovery Manager. ... Select Edit. ... On Manage eDiscovery Manager, select Choose users or Choose groups.
claims.fix: Include the omitted page heading: Settings > Role groups > Role groups for Microsoft Purview solutions > eDiscovery Manager > Edit > Manage eDiscovery Manager > Choose users. Keep the note that this assigns Managers, not Administrators.

claims.claim: Add-RoleGroupMember "eDiscoveryManager" -Member <name of security group> assigns a mail-enabled security group to the Managers subgroup.
claims.quote: You can add a mail-enabled security group as a member of the eDiscovery Managers subgroup ... by using the Add-RoleGroupMember cmdlet in Security & Compliance PowerShell. ... Add-RoleGroupMember "eDiscoveryManager" -Member <name of security group>

claims.claim: The first Choose users step assigns Managers rather than Administrators.
claims.quote: On Manage eDiscovery Manager, select Choose users or Choose groups. ... Search and select the users you want to add as an eDiscovery Manager ... Select Next. ... To assign users to the eDiscovery Administrator role group, select Choose users or Choose groups.

claims.claim: A mail-enabled security group cannot be added to the eDiscovery Administrators subgroup.
claims.quote: However, you can't add a mail-enabled security group to the eDiscovery Administrators subgroup.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Open questions
claims.claim: The documented preview path in the Microsoft Purview portal is eDiscovery > Dashboards > Hold report (preview).
claims.quote: The hold report (preview) in eDiscovery ... in the Microsoft Purview portal. ... Go to eDiscovery > Dashboards > Hold report (preview) to view your hold report.

claims.claim: Get-CaseHoldPolicy <hold policy name> -Case <case ID> -DistributionDetail is the sample script's operation for reading detailed hold status, not enabling the report.
claims.quote: $policies = Get-CaseHoldPolicy -Case $cc.Name | % { Get-CaseHoldPolicy $_.Name -Case $_.CaseId -DistributionDetail } ... -holdstatus $policy.DistributionStatus -holderror $policy.DistributionResults

claims.claim: Assigning eDiscovery permissions requires Organization Management membership or the Role Management role.
claims.quote: You need to be a member of the Organization Management role group or be assigned the Role Management role to assign eDiscovery permissions in the Microsoft Purview portal.

claims.claim: A location under multiple policies appears multiple times and contributes multiple times to the count of locations in policies.
claims.quote: If the same location is placed on hold under different policies, the same location appears multiple times in the report under the respective case and hold policy and contributes to multiple item counts.
